Sec . 4. The agencies hereinafter designated shall prescribe such rules 
as may be necessary to convert the rates of basic pay or salaries of officers 
and employees to the rates prescribed in this order :
( 1  ) General Schedule, the Civil Service Commission;

Veterans’ Administration, the Veterans’ Administration;
(3 ) Foreign Service schedules, the Department of State.
Effective Date
Sec . 5. This order shall take effect as of the first day of the 
first applicable pay period beginning on or after January 1, 1972.
